0022600015.text: The Washington Wizards (2-2, 3rd in the Southeast and one game back, 9th in the East) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-1, 1st in the Southeast, 3rd in the East) in Emirates NBA Cup East Group C play, with Washington coming off a loss and sitting 1-1 at home. Washington trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 110-103 loss in Charlotte on October 26, and it was swept 0-4 by Charlotte in the 2025-26 season. Washington will be without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Tre Johnson (Achilles soreness), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery).
